Aron drinks more and more, he overhears...
As he stretches his neck to follow the path of the only other living thing, he freezes stock still.
He switches his light off.
He looks at the picture and then into the bag.
His breathing is hard, pronounced.
He carefully tells himself..
He sees the moisture on the inside of the bag, condensation.
He licks it with his sticky tongue, twice, three times.
He looks back at the LCD screen.
Looking down onto the ground, around his leg, his toes holding the stick like a chopstick lift the knife out and up tremulously, breathlessly, towards his good arm.
He picks it off the stick gently.
Big smile. First one.
He stops it.
The sound of his absolute helplessness and need freaks him out and threatens absolute despair.
Snorts.
He rewinds to the end of the message and erases his futile calls for help.
Aron reaches in his bag and pulls out his scary looking prosthetic arm / axe. He clinks the points together.
But he also answers.

Heart rate... fast... too fast.
